quality lens over explain-on-screen (15 product path(s), 1e5515c..f1a75a4, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 2 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The main grounding and rendering paths are present, but statement changes do not reliably evict grounded results, allowing explanations for old financial data to appear under a new statement. Older explanation drill controls can also become inert.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Invalidate an in-flight grounded ask when the statement changes (frontend/src/features/assistant/use-ask.ts:198): `clearGroundedTurns` only filters turns already stored in state.

[P1] Clear persisted grounded history on the first statement after remount (frontend/src/features/mis/mis-report-view.tsx:62): The guard skips clearing whenever this `MisReportView` instance has no previous identity.
t-eos-c8: The explanation offers a declared control that opens the shipped drill panel on the focused node, for paging beyond the inline 20 rows that transactions.pageSize fixes.

t-eos-c13: Every criterion is proven by hermetic frontend leaves judged by the vitest discriminator - present AND NOT skipped AND NOT failed (D-0031) - because vitest exits 0 and marks an unmatched -t leaf skipped, so a name drift would report green having asserted nothing.

t-eos-c15: Grounded turns and focus are CLEARED when the attested statement identity changes - scope, pins or block - while ordinary Ask turns are preserved. AskProvider outlives the route, so without this an explanation of a July DUB figure stays in the dock after a different statement is generated and reads as though it describes the new numbers.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Do not leave older explanation drill controls as silent no-ops (frontend/src/features/mis/mis-report-view.tsx:201): The dock retains multiple grounded turns, but this callback opens the drill only when the clicked explanation's node and block equal the latest global focus.
